name: stick standing twist stretch
description: A gentle standing rotation with a stick across your shoulders. Loosens the mid back and trunk.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rest a stick across your upper back.
Hold it with both hands and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body slowly to one side.
Pause for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-12 slow turns and keep your knees soft.
